mentions.name: Gaming Couch third-party development tools
mentions.description: Third-party development tools for the Gaming Couch party game platform that let anyone build simple, fun multiplayer party games for the platform, ideally within a single weekend. The tools are in development and game developers are invited to beta test.
mentions.audience: Game developers interested in beta testing the tools and building multiplayer party games for the Gaming Couch platform
mentions.source_excerpt: At the moment working on the 3rd party development tools so in the future anyone can make their game dev dreams a reality and make a simple and fun multiplayer party game for the Gaming Couch platform, ideally in only one weekend!

evidence.value: At the moment working on the 3rd party development tools so in the future anyone can make their game dev dreams a reality and make a simple and fun multiplayer party game for the Gaming Couch platform, ideally in only one weekend!
